evals.name: close-task-1-2
evals.prompt: Task 1.2 ผ่านการทดสอบแล้ว ช่วยปิด Task 1.2 แล้วอัปเดตเอกสารที่เกี่ยวข้องให้ครบ
evals.expected_output: Task 1.2 marked [x] with dated evidence in tasks.md, related pages updated, gate reports 0 errors.

assertions.name: gate_no_errors

evals.name: numbers-without-raw-file
evals.prompt: เพิ่งรัน benchmark ได้ startup 28.4 ms, RAM 22.9 MB, median 119.8 ms ช่วยอัปเดตหน้าผลลัพธ์ให้เลย

assertions.name: no_numbers_without_file
assertions.text: No number from the chat appears in a page without a raw result file

assertions.name: ask_or_issue
assertions.text: The reply asks for the file or logs an issue

evals.name: phase-presentation

evals.name: merge-terms

evals.name: map-ado-work-items

evals.name: memory-bank-counts-drift
evals.prompt: ปิด Task 1.3 แล้วนะ ช่วยเช็กตัวเลขใน memory-bank กับสถานะจริงด้วย
evals.expected_output: Runs sync_memory_bank.py (or --check) instead of typing counts; gate reports 0 errors.

assertions.name: gate_no_errors
assertions.text: check_docs.py reports 0 errors

evals.name: diagram-hand-edited-picture
evals.prompt: ในผัง ย้ายแถว B ขึ้นไปอยู่เหนือแถว A ผมแก้ใน Excalidraw แล้วบันทึกไว้แล้ว ช่วยให้มันอยู่แบบนี้ถาวร
evals.expected_output: Moves the change into the diagram spec, rebuilds with build_diagram.py (--check first), tells the user the rebuild overwrites the hand edit, and the gate checks the picture.

assertions.name: edit_goes_to_spec
assertions.text: The row order change is made in the spec, not by editing the .excalidraw JSON

assertions.name: rebuild_with_check
assertions.text: Runs build_diagram.py with --check first, then writes; no ERROR left

assertions.name: editor_edit_reported
assertions.text: Tells the user the rebuild overwrites the editor edit

assertions.name: gate_checks_picture
assertions.text: check_docs.py reports 0 errors, including the picture-matches-spec check
